## Judgment phases (reviewer)

Method: the guideline and the baseline snapshot were exported (`proforma export`, 0.3.1) and compared programmatically (every precondition, wait condition, argument, recommendation and derivation; every data item's type, range, default and asking Enquiry; every Enquiry source's `mandatory`; every task's caption, description, procedure and metaprops key; every `ontology.coding`). All 151 `quote.N` values (105 distinct) were searched, after whitespace/dash normalization, in the cited resource (package-insert `.md` files, `2023-aha-acc-ccd-section-4.3.1.md` and the `pdftotext` text of the CCD guideline PDF): **151/151 found verbatim**; every label quote's `§` was located under that section heading (one, Prescribe_Low_Dose_Rivaroxaban §2.1, sits in the Highlights line tagged "( 2.1 )", which is correct). The 7 new SNOMED CT codes and 6 of the 17 LOINC test codes were re-checked with `snomed_search` / `loinc_search`; code and caption match exactly.

### Value quality (judgment)

- **Baseline diff.** Apart from R1-R6 the guideline is identical to the baseline: no task caption, description, procedure or metaprops key changed except `Order_Serum_Creatinine.procedure` and `Tests_Ordering_Recommendations_PPI_Hypomagnesemia.description` (R5, see below); 7 new Alert Actions, 7 new `suspected_*` items, 2 removed `*_check_due` items; no coding changed except the 14 new codings and the 2 removed items. PASS.
- **Triggered steps / performerInstruction.** All 29 graded tasks carry `ServiceRequest.performerInstruction`; no `trigger … no performerInstruction` WARN. PASS.
- **Descriptions and procedures.** Each alert's description says what is monitored (the suspicion recorded by its Enquiry), why (the label's instruction, no test named) and the origin (Mor Peleg's know-how, 4 Nov 2026); each procedure reads `<code>, <occurrenceTiming>. Patient: … Clinician: …`. PASS (but see the Cutaneous Lupus FAIL under ADE findings).
- **Script WARNs (14, `precondition … on an action that applies to all patients on therapy`).** Resolved, not defects: each precondition is the drug gate (`result_of(...)` of the regimen or P2Y12 Decision), not a sub-population; `all_patients_on_therapy` means every patient on the drug the label covers. Checked each gate against its label/drug: PPI monitors (Continued_Need, CDAD, Interstitial_Nephritis, Cutaneous_Lupus, Severe_Cutaneous_Reactions) = the four PPI regimens, identical to `Prescribe_PPI`'s precondition; Spinal_Epidural_Hematoma and Renal_Function = low-dose rivaroxaban + the two DOAC regimens; Perioperative_Interruption = every regimen except aspirin monotherapy; TTP = clopidogrel or prasugrel; CYP2C19 = clopidogrel (identical to `Prescribe_Clopidogrel`); Antiplatelet_Hypersensitivity = every regimen with an antiplatelet; the three ticagrelor monitors = Ticagrelor. All unchanged from the baseline. Same WARNs in the baseline gate.
- **monitored_target (29 tasks).** Every target names what is monitored and the therapy task(s) whose goal it serves (`Monitor_NSAID_Avoidance` and `Monitor_PPI_Continued_Need` name the `avoid` goals of `Advise_Avoid_Chronic_NSAIDs` / `Prescribe_PPI`, matching their `goal.verb=avoid`; `Monitor_Ischemic_Events` names the `achieve` goals; the ADE Enquiries name the drug actions as adverse-effect sources). Each alert names its suspicion, its Enquiry and the same therapy actions as the Enquiry. PASS.
- **Coding.** No missing-coding WARN. **WARN-J1:** `Monitor_Perioperative_Interruption`, `Alert_Further_Examination_Perioperative_Interruption` and `suspected_perioperative_interruption` are coded `SCT:110265006 [Postoperative hemorrhage (disorder)]`, which covers only the bleeding half of "perioperative bleeding or thrombosis". The Enquiry's code is baseline content accepted in the 2026-11-03 coding review, and Phase 3c item 7 requires the alert and its item to carry the Enquiry's concept, so this is not a FAIL; a note in `assistant_invention` (or a broader concept) would make it explicit.

### Case reports

No task has a `source_kind` containing `case_report` (kinds present: `package_insert`, `clinical_guideline`, `clinical_guideline_plus_package_insert`). Nothing to judge. PASS.

### Source fidelity

- **(a) R1 rewrites keep the meaning.** Every one of the 32 R1-only changed conditions (the 2 R5 gates are judged under (d)) was compared token by token with the baseline: each is a pure `= true` → `= "yes"`, `= false` → `= "no"` substitution, with operators, parentheses, `result_of(...)` terms and numeric comparisons (`systolic_bp < 90`, `diastolic_bp < 60`, `pulse_rate < 50`, `age_years >= 75`) unchanged; there is no `not(...)` anywhere. Under the engine, an unanswered item makes `x = false` and `x = "no"` equally false, so the truth tables are identical. `cyp2c19_status = unknown` → `= "unknown"`: the range in the baseline already held the text value `"unknown"`, and the new default `"unknown"` makes an unanswered item equal the old reading either way; meaning ("no genotype result on file") preserved. PASS for all 21 Decision arguments, `Antithrombotic_Therapy`, `Monitor_PPI_Hypomagnesemia`, `Monitor_PPI_Bone_Fracture` and the 8 test-step gates.
- **(d) R5 gates.** `Order_Serum_Creatinine` is now `vomiting_or_diarrhea = "yes" or dehydration = "yes" or new_nephrotoxic_medication = "yes" or acute_illness = "yes"`; `Tests_Ordering_Recommendations_PPI_Hypomagnesemia` is `muscle_cramps_or_spasms = "yes" or tremor = "yes" or palpitations = "yes" or seizure = "yes"`. Each reads only its Enquiry's findings (all four of each Enquiry's items, no other data item), each is exactly the baseline gate minus the `*_check_due` disjunct. The schedule survives unchanged in the monitors' `ServiceRequest.occurrenceTiming`, `goal.noun_phrase` and description: `Monitor_Renal_Function` "baseline before starting, then at least every 12 months and sooner when renal function may decline (acute illness, dehydration, new nephrotoxic drugs)"; `Monitor_PPI_Hypomagnesemia` "baseline before starting pantoprazole, then every 12 months while it continues, and on symptoms" (identical to the baseline values). The updated `Order_Serum_Creatinine` procedure and the Hypomagnesemia Decision description say the scheduled check lives in the monitor's occurrenceTiming. Both removals are in `cig-excluded` with a source-grounded §10.1 reason. PASS.
- **Quote fidelity.** 151/151 quotes verbatim in the cited document at the cited section (see Method). The alerts' `source.N`/`quote.N` pairs are byte-identical copies of pairs on their Enquiry (Ticagrelor_Dyspnea, PPI_Bone_Fracture, PPI_Cutaneous_Lupus, PPI_Severe_Cutaneous_Reactions: all pairs; Spinal_Epidural_Hematoma 2 of 3, Perioperative_Interruption 2 of 6, Antiplatelet_Hypersensitivity 2 of 4, the subsets the proposal's §6.3 bundles fix). PASS.
- **Applicability.** Population-scoped tasks (`Monitor_PPI_Hypomagnesemia`, `Monitor_PPI_Bone_Fracture` and its alert, the digoxin and CYP2C19 test steps) carry executable preconditions over Enquiry items matching their labels (PROTONIX §5.8 digoxin/diuretics, §5.4 a year or longer; BRILINTA §7.5 digoxin; PLAVIX Boxed Warning/§5.1). No unconditional action with a conditional source found. PASS.
- **Negative recommendations.** No `routine_not_recommended` task has a routine schedule; the DOAC labels' "monitoring with clotting tests is not recommended" is respected (no coagulation test ordered). The 7 alerts are `symptom_triggered_only` with event-triggered timing. PASS.
- **Label monitoring instructions.** Kept as recommended monitors: renal assessment (PRADAXA §2.4, XARELTO §5.4), magnesium (PROTONIX §5.8), digoxin levels (BRILINTA §7.5), neurological checks after neuraxial procedures (DOAC Boxed Warnings). PASS.
- **(c) The 7 alerts - provenance.** `knowledge_origin` names Mor Peleg's know-how of 4 Nov 2026 applied to the Enquiry's label passages; `assistant_invention` names the alert step, its `suspected_` gate and the further-examination order as proposed from that know-how; `provenance_type=assistant_completed_from_guidelines`, `guideline_status=not_specified_as_a_guideline_monitoring_task`. Honest. No alert orders a test (every `ServiceRequest.code` is "further clinical examination for suspected …", `instrument=clinician examination`). PASS, except the Cutaneous Lupus wording FAIL below.

### Label coverage

Every Boxed Warning and numbered §5 section of the 11 labels is accounted for (unchanged from the baseline; re-mapped here): bleeding Boxed Warnings and bleeding §5 sections of all antithrombotics, aspirin OTC "Stop use"/stomach bleeding and DURLAZA §5.1-5.2 -> `Monitor_Bleeding` (+ `Monitor_Drug_Interactions` for the aspirin-dose and NSAID warnings); PLAVIX Boxed/§5.1 -> `Monitor_CYP2C19_Poor_Metabolizer` + `Monitor_Drug_Interactions`; discontinuation sections (PLAVIX §5.3, EFFIENT §5.3, BRILINTA §5.2, DOAC Boxed (A)/§5.1-5.2) -> `Monitor_Antithrombotic_Adherence` + `Monitor_Perioperative_Interruption`; EFFIENT §5.2 CABG bleeding -> `Monitor_Perioperative_Interruption`; TTP (PLAVIX §5.4, EFFIENT §5.4) -> `Monitor_TTP`; hypersensitivity (PLAVIX §5.5, EFFIENT §5.5, BRILINTA §4.3, aspirin allergy alert) -> `Monitor_Antiplatelet_Hypersensitivity`; BRILINTA §5.3/5.4/5.6 -> the three ticagrelor monitors, §5.5/5.7 -> §10; ZONTIVITY §5.2 -> `Monitor_Drug_Interactions`; DOAC spinal/epidural Boxed (B)/§5.3-5.4 -> `Monitor_Spinal_Epidural_Hematoma`; renal sections and SAVAYSA Boxed (A) -> `Monitor_Renal_Function`; XARELTO §5.6 / PRADAXA §5.5 -> `Monitor_Drug_Interactions`; hepatic, valves, APS, acute PE, pregnancy sections -> §10.2; PROTONIX §5.2-5.6, §5.8 -> the six PPI monitors, §5.10 -> `Monitor_PPI_Continued_Need`, §5.1, 5.7, 5.9, 5.11-5.13 -> §10.2; DURLAZA §5.3 -> §10.2. No gap. PASS.

### ADE findings and test steps

- **Findings.** Each Enquiry's data items equal the baseline set (findings faithful to the metaprops, judged in the baseline review and unchanged), plus its `suspected_<ade>` item for the 7 no-test ADEs, minus the two `*_check_due` items. All yes/no items are `text` with range `"yes||yes","no||no"`; measured items keep their type and unit (`systolic_bp`/`diastolic_bp` real mmHg, `pulse_rate` integer /min, `age_years` integer years); `cyp2c19_status` keeps its three text values. Shared findings (`hematuria`, `syncope`, `fever`, `reduced_urine_output`, `joint_pain`) are one item each. PASS.
- **Finding codes.** Unchanged from the baseline except the 7 new `suspected_*` items, each coded with its Enquiry's concept (re-checked with `snomed_search`: 703861005 Spinal epidural hematoma, 110265006 Postoperative hemorrhage, 416098002 Allergy to drug, 267036007 Dyspnea, 443165006 Osteoporotic fracture of bone, 7119001 Cutaneous lupus erythematosus, 768946000 SJS/TEN spectrum - exact preferred labels). PASS (see WARN-J1).
- **Tests and LOINC codes.** The 10 test steps and their 17 LOINC codings are unchanged from the baseline; 57132-3, 28633-6, 34713-8, 34534-8, 24356-8 and 800-3 re-checked with `loinc_search` (code and long common name exact); the others are the standard codes (718-7, 4544-3, 777-3, 2532-0, 2160-0, 19123-9, 17861-6, 2823-3, 10535-3). PASS.
- **Gate conditions.** Every test-step gate is the disjunction of its Enquiry's positive findings (`= "yes"`, or the abnormal thresholds already approved), nothing else except the drug term on `Order_Serum_Digoxin` (`result_of(P2Y12_Agent_Decision) = Ticagrelor`, baseline content). PASS.
- **Display.** `Display_Potential_ADEs` is first, its caption lists the 17 ADE Enquiries in plan order; alerts are not ADEs and are rightly not listed. PASS.
- **(c) The alerts.** Each `Alert_Further_Examination_<ADE>` is in `Monitor_Undesired_State`, `after` its Enquiry, `role=ade_alert`, gated `(<Enquiry's drug gate>) and suspected_<ade> = "yes"` (the drug gate copied exactly from the Enquiry's precondition), with the full ServiceRequest contract (intent, code "further clinical examination for suspected <ADE>", occurrenceTiming "event-triggered, at the monitoring visit when <ADE> is suspected", patientInstruction, performerInstruction "examine the patient … decide on further work-up …"), `goal.noun_phrase` and procedure agreeing; each `suspected_` item is captioned "Is <ADE> suspected?", default `"no"`, coded with the ADE's concept, as is the alert's component. The sources of the Spinal, Perioperative, Hypersensitivity, Ticagrelor Dyspnea, Bone Fracture and Severe Cutaneous Reactions monitors indeed ask for no laboratory or imaging test (BRILINTA §5.3 mentions pulmonary function testing only as a trial substudy finding of no effect; DOAC labels call clotting tests not useful). PASS for 6 alerts.
- **FAIL-J1 `Alert_Further_Examination_PPI_Cutaneous_Lupus`.** Its `literature_basis` and description state that the pantoprazole label "names no laboratory or imaging test", its `ServiceRequest.performerInstruction` (and so `goal.noun_phrase` and `procedure`) says "the sources name no specific test, so none is ordered", and its `assistant_invention` says the sources "name no laboratory or imaging test". PROTONIX §5.6, the section the monitor and alert cite, does name one: "Serological testing (e.g., ANA) may be positive and elevated serological test results may take longer to resolve than clinical manifestations." The label mentions ANA only as a result that may be positive (its instruction is to discontinue and refer to a specialist), so keeping the alert instead of an ANA test step is defensible and matches the approved §10.1 decision, but the provenance text misstates the source, and Phase 3c item 3 (an alert whose sources name a test) is triggered as written. Fix below.

### Runnable defaults

- (b) Every Enquiry item has a default (80 items; 0 runnable WARNs). Yes/no findings and risk flags default to `"no"`; `age_years` 65, `systolic_bp` 120, `diastolic_bp` 80 mmHg, `pulse_rate` 70/min (all on the normal side of the approved thresholds 90/60/50 and the prasugrel age cutoff 75); `cyp2c19_status` `"unknown"` (does not fire `Order_CYP2C19_Genotype` because `ischemic_event_on_clopidogrel` defaults `"no"`). Each description says "Default … for running and testing … the clinician records the actual answer". Clinically sensible test defaults.
- `active_pathological_bleeding` is the only mandatory source (`mandatory` null in the export; every other source `mandatory :: no`); its default `"no"` satisfies `Antithrombotic_Therapy`'s precondition `active_pathological_bleeding = "no"`, and its description says the clinician must confirm the value. PASS.
- Main path re-evaluated: `Arg_Aspirin_SAPT` is the only true `for` argument, `Arg_DAPT_No_Benefit` (against) true, so only `Aspirin_Monotherapy` is recommended; `Antithrombotic_Therapy` is entered; `P2Y12_Agent_Decision` is skipped (its precondition needs a DAPT/DOAC+antiplatelet regimen); `Prescribe_Aspirin` and `Advise_Avoid_Chronic_NSAIDs` run; in `Monitor_Undesired_State` only `Monitor_Bleeding`, `Monitor_Drug_Interactions` and `Monitor_Antiplatelet_Hypersensitivity` run among the gated Enquiries; no test step and no alert fires. Matches proposal §5.2. PASS.

### Scope and structure (judgment)

Single root plan with the approved four components; `Monitoring_Plan` with the three sub-plans; scope matches the proposal (full CIG). Built Actions + monitoring Enquiries equal `cig-actions`, test Decisions equal `cig-test-decisions` (script). No differently worded duplicate monitors (each alert is a distinct step for one ADE, one alert per ADE, no ADE with both a test step and an alert). No ungraded Action.
